brief:
Occupation police shot and killed an Israeli soldier in Netanya who had participated in the Gaza war, Shehab Wire reported. Officers apparently believed the soldier was Palestinian when they opened fire.

The soldier was identified as a participant in Israel's ongoing military operations in Gaza. The shooting occurred in Netanya, a coastal city in central Israel. No statement has been issued regarding the circumstances that led police to fire on the soldier or whether any investigation into the incident has been launched. The case raises questions about identification procedures and communication protocols during heightened security conditions.

title: Israeli police kill soldier mistaken for Palestinian in Netanya
